notes.title: Christmas Gift
notes.content:
[b]Hello, dear Players! We prepared [u]little gift[/u] for you![/b]

We Congratulate you with Christmas Holidays and wish a good game!
Enter the game right now and get a gift! [b]1000 gold[/b] and [b]15 crystals[/b].

[b]HO HO HO! Merry Christmas and Happy New Year![/b]

notes.title: Servers Will Restart
notes.content:
Hello Friends,
We are pleased to report you, that we ready to upload new game feature - PvP Arena. 

For this we need to restart our servers and make a final testing. We apologize for any inconvenience. Hopefully everything will go fast and you get a new build in a few days.

Yours, Zadzen Team.
